Thanks for the context. After reviewing usage, support tickets, and the redlines, here's a proposal I believe is reasonable to present to the customer while I seek approval: 

- One-time credit: 10% of upcoming renewal invoice (applied upon renewal)
- Term reset: allow customer to move to a 6‑month renewal cycle (non-binding option to return to annual at next renewal)
- SLA addendum: one-time regional latency credit (up to $25k, payable as credit) with a commitment to provide telemetry and quarterly review
